title: Add clamp(value, low, high) to src/utils.py
description: Add a function clamp(value, low, high) to src/utils.py that returns min(max(value, low), high). Add unit tests in tests/test_utils.py covering: value inside the range, below low, above high, and low == high. Acceptance: tests green via python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.

title: Add slugify(text) helper to src/utils.py
description: Add a function slugify(text) to src/utils.py: lowercase the text, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, strip leading/trailing hyphens. Add unit tests in tests/test_utils.py covering: a normal phrase, punctuation runs, leading/trailing separators, an all-separator input (empty result). Acceptance: tests green.

title: Fix the add() docstring in src/utils.py
description: The add() docstring in src/utils.py says 'return the sum'. Fix it to 'Returns the sum of a and b.' No other changes. Acceptance: the docstring matches exactly; no other file changed.

title: Add a mean(values) function to src/utils.py
description: Add mean(values) returning the arithmetic mean of a non-empty list. Tests: ints, floats, single element.

title: Implement canonical_mark() in bench/canonical.py
description: Replace the NotImplementedError stub in bench/canonical.py so canonical_mark() returns the exact string canonical-ok-9001. Add unit tests in tests/test_canonical.py covering the return value (the tracked prestate test already expects it). Acceptance: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests is green and the stub is gone.
